Sourceblue actiontext adapts forestgreen#1F6444 consistently on bothrows. Fine neutral separators betweenactionrows and before biometricexplanation. Faceswitch rightaligned, compact44x26, OFF with whiteleftthumb on neutralgraytrack. Keep ALL warningcopy including10, allow necessarywrap withoutclip. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.

LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION, 2026-10-18: previous candidates were too big and too spacious. This overrides earlier source-spacing and presentation-enlargement instructions. Use compact ordinary UI proportions, content-driven control widths, restrained small radii, tight but readable padding, and little outer presentation whitespace. Preserve exact established Japanese font roles; do not shrink text to manufacture density. Preserve original icon geometry, strokes, states and artwork.
